    Corollary 12.4: polynomial mesh flatness #

    deformation-refinements.tex (cor:polynomial-mesh-flatness). Replace the higher coefficients in Lemma 12.3 by elements of a polynomial ring. Every fixed path basis of C is a basis of the resulting family over the polynomial ring, and it remains a basis after arbitrary base change.

    The proof is the source's: spanning holds over any coefficient ring (reduction by the original relations); independence holds over the fraction field by Lemma 12.3, hence over the polynomial ring; and the free presentation is stable under base change. We prove independence over any integral domain K receiving k, and base change along any ring map K → R.

    Coefficients are changed by cmap φ, which applies a ring map to every coefficient of a morphism of the path category.

            Corollary 12.4 (cor:polynomial-mesh-flatness): in the setting of Lemma 12.3, take the higher terms f with coefficients in a polynomial ring K = k[t_σ]. Every path basis of C is a basis of the family B_K = KQ/(𝔪^{N+1}, r − f) over K, and remains a basis after base change along any ring map K → R.
